title: BuildCraft Community Edition
description: BuildCraft Community Edition - port of original BC to newer versions
body:
# BuildCraft Community Edition

**An unofficial port of BuildCraft 8.0.0 and BuildCraft 7.1.27 to newer versions of Minecraft.**

Why BC8 + BC7? BuildCraft 8 is the latest release with a fresh take on classic BuildCraft mechanics, but not all mechanics from BuildCraft 7 were implemented in BC8, such as robotics and building features.

## Roadmap

*   Port robotics (ready)
*   Move from alpha to beta (ready)
*   Port builders (ready)
*   Global project checkup (ready)
*   Forge release for 1.19.2 (ready)
*   Port to 1.20.1 (current task)
*   Backport to 1.12.2 (current subtask)
*   Port to NeoForge/Fabric
*   Port to 1.21.1
*   Port to 1.21.11
*   Port to 26.1.2

## Current Status

Now in mod available 100% of content from BC8 and BC7

- 1.19.2 - 100%
- 1.20.1 - beta > 99% functionality
- 1.12.2 - work in progress

## Credits

### Original BuildCraft

*   GitHub: [https://github.com/BuildCraft/BuildCraft](https://github.com/BuildCraft/BuildCraft)
*   CurseForge: [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/buildcraft](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/buildcraft)
*   Modrinth: [https://modrinth.com/mod/buildcraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/buildcraft)

Special thanks to the original BuildCraft team and all contributors who made BuildCraft one of the most iconic technical Minecraft mods.

BuildCraft Community Edition is an unofficial community port based on BuildCraft 8.0.0 and BuildCraft 7.1.27, with the goal of preserving and bringing classic BuildCraft mechanics to newer Minecraft versions.

All original BuildCraft work belongs to its respective authors and contributors.
